chinese: 我在学校的棒球俱乐部，
english: I’m in my school’s baseball club,
so I play baseball quite often.

chinese: 但我觉得我们队是最好的！
english: but I think ours is the best!

chinese: 我们通常在放学后每周练习三次。
english: We usually practise three times a week after school.

chinese: 我们也进行大量锻炼，因为它让我们保持健康，帮助我们打得更好。
english: We also exercise a lot because it keeps us fit and helps us play better.

chinese: 棒球也能培养团队精神。
我们所有人都是好朋友，
english: All of us are good friends,

chinese: 无论是在场上还是场下。
english: both on and off the field.

chinese: 我们作为一个团队共同努力，我们也作为一个团队共同输赢。
english: We work as a team, and we win or lose as a team.
